{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hunter-Seeker droid dispenser''' was a type of droid dispenser used to deploy the [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]]-like [[Hunter-Seeker droid]]s commonly used in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==History==
Hunter-Seeker droids were present at the [[Skirmish at Eos]] along with the Turret droid dispenser to defend a [[Droid factory (Eos)|mining center]] on the planet.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The dispensers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].
